If you've been using it in the browser, you'll immediately notice the difference. It feels more solid, more responsive, and honestly just more like a real design tool.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-133d74h">You can grab it from <!--$--><a class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-7buhjd" href="https://magicpath.ai/" rel="">magicpath.ai</a><!--/$--> — there's a download button right on the homepage. This is a small thing on paper but a big deal in practice.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-133d74h">You also get <strong class="framer-text">components and libraries</strong> accessible from other projects, which works a lot like Figma's shared libraries. And yes, you can create and manage your own <strong class="framer-text">design systems</strong> directly in MagicPath — set your colors, typography, tokens — and reuse them across everything. Super useful if you're building multiple apps or maintaining a consistent brand.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-133d74h"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p></div><div class="framer-15e2bgf" id="section-3" data-framer-component-type="RichTextContainer" style="transform:none"><h2 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-bmjwuw">AI Agents Designing Your UI in Real Time (This Part Is Wild)</h2><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-133d74h">Here's where MagicPath 2.0 really earns its hype. When you switch to <strong class="framer-text">Agent Mode</strong> and run a prompt, you don't just get one AI quietly generating your design in the background. You get <em class="framer-text">multiple named agents</em> — Cairo, Astra, and others — each working on different screens simultaneously, visible right there on the canvas.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-133d74h">I tested this by importing a <code class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-io7tth">Design.md</code> file (a simple markdown doc describing my app's colors, typography, and overall vibe) and running a single prompt: <em class="framer-text">"Create a fitness tracker app. Show the flow of five key screens."</em></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-133d74h"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><img alt=" Design.md file (a simple markdown doc describing my app's colors, typography, and overall vibe)" width="2560" height="1440" src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/wVIQr8rDMqGBXbkH2cvAtrgO7IU.png" srcset="https://framerusercontent.com/images/wVIQr8rDMqGBXbkH2cvAtrgO7IU.png?scale-down-to=512&width=5120&height=2880 512w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/wVIQr8rDMqGBXbkH2cvAtrgO7IU.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=5120&height=2880 1024w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/wVIQr8rDMqGBXbkH2cvAtrgO7IU.png?scale-down-to=2048&width=5120&height=2880 2048w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/wVIQr8rDMqGBXbkH2cvAtrgO7IU.png?scale-down-to=4096&width=5120&height=2880 4096w,https://framerusercontent.com/images/wVIQr8rDMqGBXbkH2cvAtrgO7IU.png?width=5120&height=2880 5120w" class="framer-text framer-image framer-styles-preset-1l4p1e7" style="aspect-ratio:5120 / 2880" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 100vw, (min-width: 810px) and (max-width: 1199.98px) 100vw, (max-width: 809.98px) 100vw"><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-133d74h"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-133d74h">Within seconds, the agents kicked in.
